verdict.rationale: CDP documents agent-native payment flows: x402 lets agents pay for or charge APIs programmatically, and the Wallet MCP lets an AI assistant check balances, send funds and pay via a connected Coinbase Wallet, backed by CDP-managed key custody. However, the pack shows no explicit documentation of human-configured spend limits, allowances, or scoped permission policies constraining what an agent can autonomously spend — the closest control language ('you control auth, capture timing, partial captures, voids') applies to merchant checkout capture, not agent wallet spend caps. missing for 10: documented spend-limit/allowance configuration APIs, explicit human-set policy controls for agent wallets, and independent/hands-on confirmation of scoped-authority enforcement.
